name: category-bar

frames.best_why: Shows all three segmented bars with their markers and range labels cleanly at rest.

tagline: A stacked colour bar with a sliding marker that names the current score.
summary: A single horizontal bar split into coloured ranges, with an optional marker and labels. It plots values like a credit score or storage usage against their bands.
appearance: Thin segmented bars in pink, amber, lime and green sit inside dark cards, with small Poor to Excellent labels beneath. A slim white-ringed tick marks the current value and pops a small tooltip on hover.
behaviour: The marker glides to a new percentage when its value changes, and hovering it shows the exact figure in a small dark tooltip. Band colours are fixed per segment.
demo_content: Cards for Credit score 724, Storage used 74.2 GB and API latency 182 ms, with Poor to Excellent bands.
search_phrases: single bar made of colored segments
use_when: A value needs context against labelled ranges rather than a plain progress bar.
avoid_when: The bar is decorative for screen readers: it exposes no meter role or readable value text.
customise: Values, per-segment colours, an optional marker with tooltip and a labels toggle are props; heights and rounding are fixed classes.
weight_why: A few divs and one CSS position transition; no charting engine.

a11y.note: Exposes only an aria-label and aria-valuenow with no bar role, and the tooltip is hover-only with no keyboard path.

props.name: marker
props.type: { value: number; tooltip?: string; showAnimation?: boolean }

issues: Bar has aria-valuenow but no role, so screen readers do not treat it as a meter.
polish_why: Crisp segmented bars with clear band labels and a neat marker tooltip.
